summary: Tested the Welcome Checklist and the review-request reminders on backend and frontend. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass (tests/test_welcome_checklist_reminders.py, -n0). Approving a signup sets onboarding=true. The checklist starts at 1/4 (password step only). The note step ticks after PUT saved-notes, upload after a real POST /import, delivered after a delivered stop, and done/total reach 4/4. Admin can read the checklist; another merchant gets 403 on GET and on dismiss; unauthenticated gets 401; an unknown merchant gets 404. Dismiss sets show=false. Demo mer-1 has show=false. Reminders: run-reminders returns 401 unauthenticated and 403 for a merchant. A request backdated 8 days gets sent=1 with reminded_at set and reminder_status 'sent' (provider returned 202). A second run sends 0 and reminded_at is unchanged. Requests that are 1 day old, already submitted, or 13.9 days old are skipped. A freshly minted token for the same rid still opens GET /api/review-requests/{token}. Frontend (390px): /set-password/{token} lands on /merchant/{id} with welcome-checklist showing '1 OF 4 FIRST STEPS DONE'. After saving a note and reloading it shows 2 OF 4. HIDE removes it and it stays hidden after reload. The bakery portal shows no checklist. /admin/reviews shows 'REMINDER SENT' for the reminded request. Issues found: the admin list shows REMINDER SENT even when reminder_status is 'failed'; the checklist briefly disappears every 20s; a few minor items listed below.

minor.issue: reminded_at is claimed before sending. If every send fails (for example a 429 from the provider), reminder_status becomes 'failed' and the request is never retried, so that shop never gets its reminder. Consider retrying failed reminders on the next hourly run (for example unset reminded_at on failure, or also select reminder_status 'failed' with a retry cap).
When 12-24h are left, left.days == 0, so the copy reads 'the link stays open for 1 more days'. The plural check uses left.days instead of max(1, left.days).

The 502 HTTPException body is replaced by the ingress/Cloudflare HTML error page, so the client never sees the 'Email could not be sent: ...' detail. Seen during testing when the provider returned 429. Use a non-gateway status (for example 503 with JSON, or 424/400) so the message reaches the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: The status label uses r.reminded_at only. A request with reminder_status 'failed' still shows 'REMINDER SENT' (verified with a failed row in the DB). Show 'REMINDER FAILED' when reminder_status === 'failed'. Reference: frontend/app/admin/reviews.tsx:120

integration_issues.issue: refreshKey={q.dataUpdatedAt} is part of the checklist queryKey. Every 20s merchant refetch creates a new query with no data, so the component returns null until the fetch finishes: the checklist disappears briefly and the content below jumps (seen in 1 of 130 samples at 200ms intervals). Old keys also pile up in the cache. Use a fixed key ['checklist', merchantId] and call refetch/invalidate when dataUpdatedAt changes, or set placeholderData: keepPreviousData. Also, saving a note does not update the checklist until the next refetch or reload. Reference: frontend/src/components/WelcomeChecklist.tsx:15, frontend/app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:123

issues: When an admin opens a shop's portal and taps HIDE, the checklist is dismissed for the shop too. Consider allowing only the merchant to dismiss it, or labelling the button for the admin.

action_items: admin/reviews.tsx:120: show 'REMINDER FAILED' (or 'REMINDER PENDING') when reminder_status is 'failed' instead of 'REMINDER SENT'.

WelcomeChecklist: stop putting dataUpdatedAt in the queryKey. Use a stable key plus a refetch on change, or keepPreviousData, to remove the flicker every 20s. Optionally invalidate ['checklist', id] after a saved note or a CSV upload.
send_review_reminders: retry reminders that failed (for example because of the provider's 429 limit) on a later run, and fix the '1 more days' plural.
POST /admin/review-requests: avoid the 502 status so the error detail is not replaced by the ingress HTML page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is about 3925 lines; split it into modules (auth, email/review/signup, merchants).
Claim-before-send in send_review_reminders is race-safe (conditional update on reminded_at None). Good.
The reminder token's expiry is set to the original link's remaining time. Good.
The checklist endpoint makes 3 find_one queries per call and is polled every 20s per open portal. Cheap, but make sure stops has an index on merchant_id+status.
The backend runs uvicorn --reload watching /app/backend, so any file created under backend/tests restarts the server (it caused a 502 during testing). This is an environment note, not an app bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 UI label bug (failed reminder shown as sent) and 1 flicker issue

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted: TEST_ signup requests with their merchants (mer-20a506a3 etc.), users, saved_notes, import_jobs/rows and stops, all review_requests (including the TEST_rr_failed row), testimonials, and drv/trk login_attempts. Only mer-1 and mer-2 remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_welcome_checklist_reminders.py with -n0. It approves a real signup (sends 2-3 emails) and sends 2 more for the review request and its reminder. The provider rate-limits about 3 emails in ~5s, and recovering from a 429 took more than 1 minute. Creating files under /app/backend restarts uvicorn, so wait about 3s after writing test files. prep_ui_iter25.py mints a setpw token for a fresh approved TEST_ shop; prep_ui_reminder_iter25.py makes a reminded review request for mer-1.
rca_of_issue: Flicker: the queryKey includes refreshKey=dataUpdatedAt, which changes every 20s, so react-query starts a new query with data undefined and `if (!q.data?.show) return null` unmounts the box until the fetch resolves. Failed-reminder label: the UI checks reminded_at, which is set at claim time before the send, not reminder_status.
